100m-yuan-wife-buy-one-get-one:

Seven years later, she returned with the lady killer’s genius son, never expecting that her darling son would sell her out to MBS International. Unexpectedly, her immediate superior was the Mr. ￥100 from seven years ago!
“……Terrible girl, seven years ago, you dared to humiliate me so much! This time, I’ll definitely let you pay the price! For ￥1,000,000,000,000, I’ll buy you for the rest of your life!”
Isn’t that too much for a buy one get one free bargain? The most two-faced couple, along with their two-faced son, staking their lives on the outcome…
above-your-head:

A second-year high school student who looks ordinary but is not ordinary.
He has a secret he couldn’t tell anyone…
And it was that he was able to see the ‘Affiliation’ and ‘State’ above the heads of the people.

It was already tough as it was, but he keeps getting entangled with his ability and extraterrestrial beings!

becoming-a-tech-tycoon-begins-with-regre:

Supercomputers? AI? Quantum processors? Bioengineering? The system provided blueprints to all.
Now, armed with the knowledge of the future, Ethan will rise as a tech industry giant, crush his enemies, and build an empire that no one can overthrow!
Wealth, power, and revenge—this time, he’s taking it all!

emperor-of-the-source:
Adrian Blackwood awakened to an affinity no one believed possible.
Not [Space], not [Time], but the [Source], the origin of all powers.
While others train for years to master a single element, Adrian devours them all. Lightning, fire, gravity… even life, death, and time. Everything bends back to the Source.
Yet power alone cannot save a world drowning in endless waves of monsters. Not when even S-rank commanders bleed on the battlefield.
To protect humanity, Adrian will break every limit. To protect those he loves, he will shatter the very rules of existence.
He will not be a weapon.
He will rule the Source as its Emperor.
What to Expect:
[+] Power fantasy, cosmic scale. From defending humanity on Earth, to galaxies, to universes, and finally to existence itself. If you like Infinite Mana in the Apocalypse, you’ll feel right at home.
[+] MC-focused. The story follows Adrian’s rise as he grows into the Emperor of the Source.
[+] Daily uploads. At least 1 chapter a day, 1k–2k words per chapter.
[+] Fast-Paced Story. Mastering affinities, devouring concepts, and breaking the very laws of mana.

global-stream-starting-with-1000x-increa:
In this bizarre new era, Dan Moriarty finds himself thrown into a world far beyond imagination after transmigrating from earth to the All-Heaven Star System. But before his arrival, the All Gods Continent descends, reshaping reality itself. From that day onward, every human who reaches the age of 18 can connect to the Streaming Network, enter deadly dungeons, and have their battles broadcast across countless realms to be watched by innumerable beings.
Among the viewers are Celestial Immortals, Abyssal Demons, Ancient Dragons, Void Monarchs, Titan Warlords, Divine Beast Clans, Star Lords, Spirit Emperors, and forgotten gods from ruined worlds.
Those who entertain these mighty spectators are rewarded with gifts in the form of skills, treasures, bloodlines, weapons, and unimaginable fortunes.

And starting with 1,000× multiplier, every gift he receives is enhanced a thousandfold the moment it enters his hands.

i-became-the-villainess-but-my-beast-hus:

But instead of resting in peace, she wakes up in the body of Roxanna Vixelle, the infamous Pink Fox villainess who tortured her five beast husbands for fun.

Humanity was near extinction in the apocalypse brought forth by the appearance of Monsters in the once peaceful world. Their last hope... The mystical tower that had appeared out of nowhere became the shelter of humanity.

my-apocalypse-system-arrives-10-years-ea:
After fresh rain in the empty mountains, the evening air brings the feel of autumn. Li Xiang brandished his self-made High-Density Chopping Knife, and with a single strike, a bamboo stalk as thick as a bowl's mouth snapped and broke.
Suddenly, an ordinary earth viper shot out.
With a gentle flick of his knife's tip, Li Xiang severed the earth viper's vital spot, and its ferocious head fell to the ground.
System: “Congratulations, Host, for killing the Tier One Exotic Beast. You have received a surprise reward.”
“What the hell? This ordinary earth snake is an Exotic Beast?” Li Xiang pinched his chin and fell into deep thought. “...It's supposed to mutate ten years from now when the Apocalypse arrives and demonic and monstrous energies invade, right? Hmm, I've just slain an Exotic Beast in its infancy. My merit is immeasurable.”

my-ferocious-tigress-wife:
Xiao Baoxin is different from other girls—she can hear the most genuine thoughts inside everyone’s hearts.
When her aunt-in-law confides in her, Xiao Baoxin clearly hears the thoughts that contradicts everything her aunt-in-law says. Thanks to this ability, Xiao Baoxin realizes that her fiancé does not truly love her. After insisting on ending their engagement, she encounters a man who doesn’t wear his heart on his sleeve.
In dealing with Xiao Baoxin’s coquettishness and adamant pursuit, this man named Xie Xian rejects Xiao Baoxin with his body and soul—”Lady, please protect thy modesty. I doth not liketh thee.”
Yet, Xiao Baoxin clearly hears the roar that comes from within his heart: “Kiss me already!”

parallel-world-light-novelist:
Haruto was just an ordinary high schooler trying to survive after his father’s business collapsed and left behind massive debt.
Then the memories started coming.
Memories of masterpieces from another world, stories that had never existed in this timeline, yet had the power to make millions laugh, cry, and lose sleep over fictional characters.
So he picks up a pen and starts writing.
From the bittersweet romance of Blue Spring Ride to the emotional devastation of Anohana, Haruto claws his way up the cutthroat light novel industry one tearjerker at a time. His readers adore him, curse him, and still buy the next volume anyway.
Unfortunately… he still has many stories left to tell.
——————
MC branches out to manga, anime, games and others as the story progress.
He only writes script for them.
He writes novels till the end.
[Blue Spring Ride]
[Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day]
[Parasyte]

The alien DNA is the best thing that has ever happened to Ye Shuang because the genetic optimization it offers has made her more beautiful, more formidable, and more brilliant.

surrounded-by-the-billionaires-deep-doti:
“Su Xiaomeng, about that night—”
One sentence from Yin Shixiu and her world tilts.
He’s her best friend’s thirty-two-year-old uncle, a man whose name opens every door in the city, and the last person she wants to tangle with.
“Uncle, look—you weren’t thinking straight and I was blackout drunk. Let’s just pretend it never happened, okay?”
“…Fine.”
Three months later he discovers—via an excited niece—that Su Xiaomeng is pregnant.
“The moment the baby’s born, you let me leave. No more hounding me!”
“…Fine.”
He signs the marriage contract she writes herself.
“Uncle, I need spicy hot pot at midnight…”
“…Fine.”
He’s out the door in the snow, gathering ingredients until his fingers turn blue.
“Uncle, I’m scared. He’s kicking so hard—it hurts…”
“Alright, alright—no more babies after this.”
On the eve of delivery, he strokes her back, whispering promises until her breathing steadies.
surviving-the-apocalypse-with-a-wife-and:
Bai Li suddenly wakes up to find herself transmigrated into the world of a book as one of the countless cannon fodder followers of the heroine, Yan Cijin and what’s more, there’s even a system in her head, claiming to be some sort of survival mod system! But that’s not all! The world she is transported into is a world which is nearing its end and a huge zombie apocalypse is about to break out soon!

According to the system, in the original book, Yan Cijin was an abused heroine who was constantly surrounded and pursued by a bunch of crazed and obsessive male leads who wanted to take ownership of her. Yan Cijin was always running away from them with her little daughter and trying to survive but as if the author hates her, he constantly makes her life harder, filled with betrayals, being found out every time and escaping with her life on the line. This same routine continued for years but one day, Yan Cijin’s daughter was killed by the trap set by the male leads. That day changed everything.…

Ye Wanwan, in her past life, had a husband who neither loved her nor was close to his son. Upon rebirth, she had an epiphany; she would not wholeheartedly and recklessly love someone again.

Shen Yi was busy with work, especially after being appointed by his father to establish an overseas branch. He hadn't returned home for two months, nor had he seen his wife.
On his wife's birthday, he made a special trip back to the country, but learned from a servant that his wife had gone to a singer's concert. Shen Yi didn't even see her and left that same night.
On their wedding anniversary, Shen Yi came back to the country again, only to find his wife throwing a pool party with a bunch of fair-weather friends at their villa, ending up drunk. He didn't even get a chance to speak a few words to her before he had to leave once more.
Having initially completed the establishment of the overseas company, Shen Yi officially returned to the country.…

Be it human, demon, or beast.

“It's just that they themselves don't know. When I hunted the first demonic beast and plundered its entry, I think I found the meaning of battle!”

From [Berserk] to the race-crushing [Critical Hit Amplification]

The gods gaze down from the starry sky, while ten thousand demons whisper in the abyss.
Lin Yi stands atop a high tower built from the white bones of countless demons and monsters.
He looks up at the starry sky, his eyes revealing a suffocating madness.

the-lowest-ranked-hero-has-returned:
The first time I realized that I ‘couldn’t die’ was during a practical training exercise in my third year as a hero cadet.
A beast suddenly leaped out of the bushes and tore into my neck.
‘How did I come back to life?’
Yes, I came back to life. I didn’t die.
And now, after hundreds, even thousands of years, I was still alive. Only I had survived.

Now, the very first problem he has to face is… a ‘female devil’ who can’t be easily described in a few words…

valerian-the-legendary:
In this world, some say, the truth and the legends are the same. One such legend belonged to the protagonist, Valerian.
Valerian was an orphan, a boy blessed with a beautiful face, and everyone around him, could not help but want to play with him, till one day a prophet passing through their town pronounced him to be cursed.
Since that day, the destiny of the boy seemed to have changed completely, he was shunned by everyone around him, and the gazes that were earlier filled with love and affection, now brimmed with disgust and hatred.
The constant shunning and humiliation made the cheerful child grow up to be bitter and inexpectant. On his seventh birthday, things changed once again.
This time, it was not the people around him who went through a change, but himself. As he grew up, Valerian became a legend in his own sense.
The people sang of a boy, who could not speak, they shed tears for a boy, who could not grieve. He came from nowhere yet he was known everywhere.

“If you think you aren’t having enough fun... Well, perhaps we could play the divorce game, then we could have another marriage, making the same vow with you always as my bride. I can do this, again and again. Again, and again.…
